mentions.description: A long-running niche product for WordPress plugin and theme updates, in active development for ten years and maintained as a solo codebase.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been fiddling with a long-term niche product for WordPress plugin and theme updates. It's 10(!) years old this year. Working in a code base that old 100% of my own commits is both amazing and terrifying.
